headline: FDU and Central Connecticut finish level on top
dek: FDU and Central Connecticut ended the conference schedule with identical records, and drew when they met again seven days after Central Connecticut's home win. FDU has conceded eleven goals in nineteen matches all season.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Goals have not sorted this conference: Stonehill has 36, more than every program but FDU, and has lost eight matches while winning seven.

wire.line: Outside conference play, league sides have won nine matches and lost 58.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches have passed their date with no result, and both are Delaware State's, from August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Melina Ford has conceded 23 of Central Connecticut's 24 goals against this season.

last_match.line: Central Connecticut had not lost since Wagner beat it in September.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
